run_f_gold: run f_gold to add 1 to a given integer using bitwise XOR and shift operations
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple integer inputs to verify it correctly adds 1 via bitwise logic
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the bitwise addition loop with a simple x + 1 expression
